participation.context: Added a few lines at the foot of Sunday's sheet and did not finish them.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

story.body: You wrote that she is at the hedge and does not go in, and you stopped before the day could close.

title: Wrote the queen as far as the hedge

participation.context: Spoke the residue of the rehearsal and stopped.
participation.name: William Shakespeare

participation.context: Named as absent, and as not shown the book.
participation.name: Will Kemp

story.body: You set the eight lines down as no improvement, and you did not take the king's paper to Kemp.

title: Noted the eight lines and the break at eleven
